title: Sky (MIT & Norman Foster)
teaser: Structural prototyping and material research for scalable drone infrastructure in emerging economies.
headline: A global infrastructure concept where design engineering had to connect material logic, social need, and delivery systems.
challenge: The Droneport concept needed a credible structural and material story for scalable medical delivery infrastructure in emerging economies.
outcome: Ali contributed design engineering and prototype thinking within a research context tied to Norman Foster Foundation, MIT Media Lab, and global housing and logistics questions.
bullets: Collaborated on future-city and housing research tied to Lord Norman Foster and MIT Media Lab.
Explored structural prototyping and earth-brick material systems for drone-enabled medical delivery infrastructure.
Selected as one of ten global designers for the initiative.
